title: Collapsible property desync in inspector
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in `4.8.dev`[f5af328], `4.6.stable`.
~Not reproduced in `4.6.stable`.~

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (f5af32893) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In the inspector, the "collapsible" icon desyncs from the expanded/collapsed state of the properties. Sometimes the icon changes when the cursor hovers over it. Sometimes clicking the icon only changes it without expanding/collapsing the properties.

Video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5a1a8023-0812-41ec-948c-e91990409b24

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the inspector.
2. Try to hover the cursor on several "collapsible" icons.
3. Click on one of the icons.
4. Move the cursor to another nearby icon above/below.
5. Repeat steps 2-4.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Probably not project-specific, but here is the MRP I used in the video:
[MRP_Collapsible_Property_Desync.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29809763/MRP_Collapsible_Property_Desync.zip)
